set session transaction isolation level repeatable read

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(O.ORDER_DATE, '%Y-%m') AS PERIOD, CONCAT(SUBSTRING('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (MONTH(O.ORDER_DATE) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3), ' ', YEAR(O.ORDER_DATE)) AS MONTH_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT O.ORDER_ID) AS ORDERS, SUM(L.QUANTITY) AS UNITS, SUM(L.QUANTITY*L.UNIT_PRICE*(1-L.DISCOUNT/100.0)) AS SALES FROM ORDERS O JOIN ORDER_LINES L ON L.ORDER_ID = O.ORDER_ID WHERE O.ORDER_DATE BETWEEN DATE(timestamp('2025-01-01 00:00:00.000000')) AND DATE(timestamp('2025-12-31 00:00:00.000000')) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
